story_review.one_viewing_summary: Watched muted, spoken marks turn into an AI-drafted visit note beside an empty check box. A university plan stalls short of one unified system after two pilots, and physician outlines fill without a date. A dated vendor release ties to a UT initiative whose framework reaches institutions that keep their own switches. The vendor's design threads the draft to its source while a check hovers unplaced. A Texas Act card lights diagnosis and a readable review-all-AI-records condition with board standards beneath it. A visit note meets the diagnosis frame under a question mark. Vendor and law threads converge on the still-empty box beside a how-well field stamped not stated.
story_review.opening_to_ending: It opens on an empty box beside a fresh AI draft asking who verifies it. It ends on the same empty box with both the vendor's and the statute's threads pointing at it and the quality of the check marked not stated. That is a source-honest answer that invents no outcome.
